en.p: For a real number $t$ with $-1\le t\le 1$, among the real roots of the equation in $x$
that belong to the set $\{x\mid 0\le x<4\}$, let $\alpha(t)$ be the smallest and $\beta(t)$ the largest. Which of the statements in <Statements> are correct? [4 points]

box: a. For every real number $t$ with $-1\le t<0$, $\alpha(t)+\beta(t)=5$.
c. For two real numbers $t_1$, $t_2$ with $\alpha(t_1)=\alpha(t_2)$, if $t_2-t_1=\dfrac{1}{2}$, then $t_1\times t_2=\dfrac{1}{3}$.
